mathematics.logical_review: The root and two specialist AI agents independently audited the full arbitrary-n indexed Koszul theorem. They checked dual mixed-projection surjectivity, ideal normality of zeta, support {0,2} of E/(zeta), both local AS complement arguments, and the crucial D4 vanishing F^(d-2)=0 from its partner E^2_e4=R6*=0. This excludes every formerly apparent Koszul exception without a matrix generator-bound assumption. The N9 three-class necessary conditions were independently audited for positive boundary kernels, exact saturated rows, vanishing of the relevant Schur corrections and the explicit nondegeneracy requirement. Current N4 three-divisibility and nozz proofs retain their completed internal audits. These are mathematical/internal AI audits, not formalization, external peer review or verified novelty. The root and a specialist independently verified the classical Heisenberg comparison, its quadratic presentation and central commutator, PBW Hilbert series/domain argument, exact nonKoszul Hilbert obstruction, exterior quadratic dual and the general augmentation-indecomposable formula for Lie enveloping algebras. This verifies a known comparison example outside the target, not existence or nonexistence of nonKoszul Qn_dom objects. For the hypothetical N9 branch, the root and specialist checked the E3 word4/5 annihilation and complementary pairing by word support. The root additionally checked that all E3 word>3 components inject into E/(zeta), and that a nonzero word4/5 pair forces odd excess in this quotient. These statements do not assert that the branch or its central components exist.
mathematics.scope: For arbitrary n, all word-Koszul Qn_dom objects have full indexed two-step Ore, Koszul ASn pure base, standard bigraded H and L=n+5 without H/noetherian/nozz/period-one assumptions. Even n also gives ordinary descent. The original word-quadratic problem without Koszulity remains open for n>=4, exactly at automaticity of r3=n,r5=1. At n4, D3 and 3|N,3|L are unconditional; the first non-Koszul remainder is N9/L12, with proved averaged three-class boundary conditions. The ten-condition n4 equivalence, lower-dimensional full results, general normal-z criterion, nozz conditions and formal obstruction assets remain valid. No nonKoszul target example has been constructed or found in the checked primary sources. The N9 and higher n4 possibilities are hypothetical residual cases. The known four-generator Heisenberg AS5 example is documented only as an outside-target comparison.

The exact w^j coefficient ideal is I_j=F(R+mu R+...+mu^j R)F; mu(R)=R is not assumed in this step. Stabilization takes place in finite-dimensional F2.
The highest Q bidegree has J=(L_A-N_A-1)/2 and a=N_A-1-J, uniform over the folded vertices. Nonnegative bar bidegrees and AS duality imply J>=1.

P_J=(-1)^d*x^a*Pi*P_0(x^-1)^T is invertible over Q((x)); therefore P_J G_N cannot vanish. The equation P G=I-tT forces J1 and G constant. This is not an invalid determinant or arbitrary-matrix degree argument.

Equal Hilbert matrices for the nested coefficient ideals imply equality in every finite component; the degree-two comparison gives mu(R)=R. Returning to the original cover gives a regular normal jump-three family and the second AS quotient.

The new periodic R5 saturation proof was independently checked by the root and two agents. The explicit positive-weight curve respects b^2=ac and convergence; the Poisson correction of an orbit-constant positive left vector avoids any unjustified analytic perturbation of a multiple zero eigenvalue. Only one saturated mod-three class is concluded when 3 divides L.
The N4 top-word theorem covers every N not divisible by three, not merely a fixed N7 formal model. Its remaining non-Koszul words are N=9,12,15,... .

Nozz is explicitly additional and invariant only for the fixed word grading and jump-preserving basis changes. Koszulity is required in the Frobenius recognition result; the second periodic result replaces it by all r5=1 and an actual period not divisible by six.
General pure tail lower bounds sum_j p_ij>=2q_i and r2_i>=3+q_i follow from cancellation and minimal exactness even without word concentration.
The formal matrix generator-bound obstruction is not an algebra and fails domain component comparison; it is not a counterexample to the target theorem.
The Koszul recognition uses only E zeta=zeta E, not an unproved normalizing automorphism for the dual zero-divisor.
In the last D4 case the AS complement of eta has homological degree d-1 and excess 2, while its quotient component is Fbar^(d-2) eta. AS pairing with E^2_e4=0 proves this component vanishes.
The N9 exact-two-saturated-class equality requires gamma_(r+1)!=0. No condition is extrapolated to the degenerate branch or from an average to individual ranks.

The classical quadratic Heisenberg AS5 example has four minimal generators and is outside Qn_dom; C! is exterior4 modulo the symplectic form, has H=1+4t+5t^2 and is not full Ext. For finite-dimensional positively graded Lie g, augmentation indecomposables equal g/[g,g], so equality of minimal generator count and AS dimension forces g abelian.
